name: 多样品无缝堆叠分峰图 (Stacked Deconvolution Peak-Fit)
when: Peak-fitted spectra (29Si MAS NMR, NH3-TPD, H2-TPR) showing observed curve, total fit envelope, and N Gaussian/Lorentzian components with Origin-style vertical-gradient pastel fills stacked seamlessly (hspace=0) inside a shared outer frame.

required_slots.x: Independent axis (ppm for 29Si NMR; Temperature °C for NH3-TPD / H2-TPR).
required_slots.y_fit: Total fitted envelope (sum of components + baseline).
required_slots.components: 2..7 deconvolved component peak columns (e.g. Q1-Q4 or S1-S4).

optional_slots.sample_groups: 3 or 4 samples stacked vertically as subpanels (hspace=0).
optional_slots.peak_markers: Short vertical leader ticks + peak labels (Q1-Q4 or S1-S4) on the top subpanel only.

data_contract.x_direction: ascending for TPD/TPR (100-700 °C); descending for 29Si NMR (e.g. [-80, -120] ppm)
data_contract.y_meaning: Intensity / TCD signal (a.u.) with numeric y-ticks hidden.
constraints: CRITICAL: Vertical sample order must match reference! Fig4A bottom->top = Support (red), Catalyst-A (blue), Catalyst-B (purple), Catalyst-C (green). Fig5B bottom->top = Catalyst-A, Catalyst-B, Catalyst-C.
Verify component sum vs total fit (max residual < 1e-6 or document baseline term).
Use vertical gradient fills (top-to-bottom fading to white, NOT flat uniform alpha which turns overlap regions muddy brown).

notes: PeakFit TXT files have line 0 = source path metadata (`skiprows: 1`, `header: false`): cols = [X_obs, Y_obs, X_gen, Y_gen, Peak1, Peak2, Peak3, Peak4].
Peak1..4 column order may NOT match left-to-right S1..S4 order — always verify peak center x!
Fill colors: #B3CDE4 (S1/Q1 blue), #CCEAC4 (S2/Q2 green), #FBB4AE (S3/Q3 salmon), #DECAE5 (S4/Q4 lilac), #B0B0B0 (extra/fit).
Seamless subpanels share one outer frame (1.55 pt) with crisp internal horizontal dividers (1.0-1.55 pt) and independent y-limits (document in QA that peak heights are normalized per subpanel).
